title: Block skeletons
description: The block template the Code editor offers for a block command the script has not used yet (docs/name-lookup-design.md Sec.13.4.1). Generated by `npm run generate:skeletons` from the maps on a maintainer's disk, each map voting once. Never edited by hand.

maps.description: How many maps the generator read.

key.description: A block command's name, or the command with its arguments separated by single spaces (`create_object GOLD`).

maps.description: How many maps have a block under this key. The generator writes no key with fewer than three.

attributes.description: The attributes kept, in the order they are written.

values.description: One starting value per argument, each a tab stop in the template.
